description: Search PORTUGUESE public-procurement tender ANNOUNCEMENTS (contract notices) published through Portal BASE (base.gov.pt), run by IMPIC (Instituto dos Mercados Públicos, do Imobiliário e da Construção). IMPIC's own live API needs registration and a token Pipeworx does not hold yet, so this answers from a refreshed recent-window dataset (see data_as_of and the window fields in the response). Filter by free-text keyword (matched against the Portuguese notice title), CPV classification code or prefix (e.g. "45" for construction, "72000000" for IT services), contracting-authority (buyer) name substring (Portuguese spelling, e.g. "Câmara Municipal", "Instituto"), and a publish-date range. Returns compact shaped notices: id, IMPIC notice id, buyer, title, notice type, contract type(s), base amount (EUR), CPV, publish date, and proposal deadline. Call pt_announcement_detail with the returned id for the full record.

buyer.description: Contracting-authority (buyer) name, partial match, Portuguese spelling, e.g. "Câmara Municipal de Lisboa", "Instituto", "Universidade".

cpv.description: CPV classification code or numeric prefix, e.g. "45" (construction works), "72000000" (IT services).

date_from.description: Earliest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 90 days before date_to.

date_to.description: Latest PUBLISH date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the newest date in the loaded window (see ann_window_to in any response), which can trail today because IMPIC publishes per-year bulk files.

limit.description: Max notices to return (default 20, max 100). Newest-first.

query.description: Keyword(s), case-insensitive, matched against the Portuguese notice title, e.g. "limpeza", "software", "obras", "manutenção".

name: pt_announcement_search
title: Pt Announcement Search
